title: Pear (Marasebu): modeled ₹1,523/qtl left, Kangra (Baijnath) → Una
summary: September 2023: reported pear (Marasebu) prices at Kangra (Baijnath) and Una imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 81% of 21 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹1,523 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 44 same-variety market pairs screened for pear (Marasebu) in September 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) at both markets; sale matched to the first Una report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: September 2023
scenes.caption: Kangra (Baijnath) (Himachal Pradesh) and Una (Himachal Pradesh) both reported pear (Marasebu) prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) on 21 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kangra (Baijnath) reported a median ₹6,500 per quintal. Una reported a median ₹8,800 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹2,000/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹2,000 per quintal, and Una was dearer on 90% of days.

scenes.headline: 93 km by road
scenes.caption: 93 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹20/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹1,254 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹847 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Una report, the rule selects 17 of 21 modeled shipping days. 15 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹1,523 per quintal (₹1,069 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Pear (Marasebu) route from Kangra (Baijnath) to Una was positive on 81% of matched days in September 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹152,300, or ₹106,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to pear (Marasebu)
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹20/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Pear (Marasebu) route from Kangra (Baijnath) to Una was positive on 81% of matched days in September 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹152,300, or ₹106,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

sources.title: Agmarknet / data.gov.in daily mandi modal prices (retained AGRINET snapshot)
RBI Working Paper WPS (DEPR) 08/2024 — Price Dynamics of Tomato, Onion and Potato
